https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R5-jiQ98pSU

值得閱讀的理由

  • 學習如何利用 Windows 11 內建 AI 動作功能快速置換純綠色背景並微調細節。
  • 掌握 AI 圖生影片（Image-to-Video）的提示詞技巧與參數設定，確保背景維持乾淨純色。
  • 學會在 CapCut 中運用色度摳圖精準去背並疊加背景素材，解決角色透光破圖瑕疵。

摘要

準備綠幕圖片與細節修復

作者首先示範如何運用 Windows 11 的 AI 動作為小惡魔圖片更換純綠色背景。在過程中若遇到角色邊緣或尾巴遺漏的情形，作者透過背景筆刷工具與增減遮罩功能，細緻調節筆刷大小與柔和度來補齊細節，並將完成的綠幕靜態圖儲存備用。

利用 AI 圖生影片技術生成動態畫面

隨後，作者將圖片上傳至 RunwayML 相關平台進行圖生影片。作者將時長設定為 10 秒並調節生成速度，同時強調提示詞（Prompt）的撰寫核心在於明確要求 AI 維持純綠色背景的一致性，以利後續的去背合成作業。

於 CapCut 進行色度去背與合成調整

生成完畢後，作者將影片下載並匯入 CapCut，使用色度摳圖（Chroma Key）吸取綠色背景以達到透明效果。為避免角色身體因去背過度而產生穿透感，作者示範如何即時微調強度與陰影數值，最後在底層疊加影片素材並設定為 9:16 比例，完成自然精緻的影像合成。

================================================

This time, I will talk about how to use MXH 3's image-to-video to generate green screen videos. Then we can go into CapCut to use this green screen for some compositing effects. First, go to this RingHub app I've set up. I will include the URL in the video description. Next, we need to upload an image because we are doing. image-to-video generation. This image is a green screen background. Okay, we are using the first frame, so the last frame isn't needed. We want the speed to be a bit faster, so set it to 0.4. Once you've tested and it's correct, you can set it to 0.9, and the duration is 10 seconds. We won't use prompt optimization; we'll just use our own. prompts. I plan to use this image, the little devil one, and I want to turn it into a green screen. If you are on Windows 11, you can right-click on the image. Select "AI Actions." Choose " Blur Background" from the photo options here. It's right here. Then there is a feature called "Replace." Over here in.

the replace section. We enter the green screen color here, which is just the green background color. I'm entering this specific color here. This is the green color I plan to use. We can use the mouse scroll wheel to zoom the image in and out. You can also hold down the middle mouse button to move around. Now that we've zoomed in, we. can see the tail is missing, so we need to make some adjustments. Scroll down a little bit, and we can see a background brush tool. Let's open that. Here you can choose to "Add Mask" or "Remove Mask.""Add Mask" means that as you can see when I draw, it adds to the selection, meaning I want to keep that part of the character. But since my. tail isn't fully appearing, I need to " Remove Mask," so I'll click this one. Then I can go ahead and remove it here. But this brush is too big, let's go back. We can adjust the brush size. We can also zoom in a little bit more, that makes it easier to control. Then there is the brush softness, which determines if there is any feathering around the edges. Okay, let's paint.

here to fill in the tail. There are some edges that went off, so I can use the "Add Mask" option to fix it. We'll need to handle other areas too. Once the upper part of the tail is done, we can close it and it will look like this . It should be about right. Next, just. save the file. Select this, and then we can take this image to our RunwayML hub . We drag it into this center area. Next is writing the prompt; I tried. several times to find one that works well. I will just paste the successful prompt directly. This is the successful prompt. The main thing is that the prompt must mention maintaining a consistent background, which should.

stay as a solid green—the same green we chose when we picked the AI color earlier. Then we click "Run Now." This is the main part; everyone can take a look here. Okay, it's generated, so. let's see how the effect turned out. Good. It's decent; the green remains consistent. So now we can head over to CapCut to process it. We need to download it, so select download. We go. to CapCut, import the file we just downloaded, and add it to the timeline. Here is the video we just generated. Next, we want to remove the background, so click on it and choose "Cutout." Then select "Chroma Key" here. Use the.

color picker to select the green background; you can see the background has turned black. Next, we need to adjust the intensity. This intensity slider. You can also adjust the "Shadow " or "Edge Feather." Reduce the white parts a bit, and adjust the edge cleaning as needed based on your actual footage. Alright, now we can add other. elements behind this video. We can choose a 素材, there's a section called "Stock Videos," let's just pick one randomly, maybe this one. This one We add it in. And the AI video we just。finished should be placed on top like this. You can see it here, let's pull it a bit. Stretch it out a little like this. Then for the aspect ratio, we choose 9:16 here. Okay, up to here. You can crop it. Okay, you can see that our.

cutout wasn't perfectly done. So, some parts of the body are see-through, revealing the background underneath. We can adjust this, for example, the intensity; look at the intensity, wasn't this part supposed to be transparent? You can see right through this part, so we can turn the intensity down a bit; same here, let's lower it. Let's take another look; because the background was black earlier, it was actually hard to see the real situation . So, once you place a video clip underneath it, it becomes much easier to see the actual effect. Alright, it looks like these settings are pretty good for now. Let's take a full look at. this effect; first, we'll mute the audio on this channel and keep only the audio from the clip below, then we'll play it. Alright, that's the effect. That's it for this video; I hope you'll like, subscribe, share, and hit the notification bell.
